title: Naval units in the Candy look: a chocolate-bar boat with a wafer sail, a layered-cake galleon with candy-cane masts and a donut-ring raft, and the two warship portraits

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a chocolate-bar boat: the hull becomes a dark chocolate bar #5a3423 marked into square blocks with a thick rim of pale pink frosting #ffb8d8; the red sail becomes a pale biscuit wafer #e9c98f with a waffle grid; the mast becomes a pink and white striped candy cane; the pennant becomes pale pink. Nothing red. Keep the boat shape, size, waterline, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 cog as a chocolate-bar boat with a wafer sail, the shared hull's footprint and waterline (NAVAL_FACTIONS.md).

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a layered-cake galleon: the hull becomes layers of pale cream sponge cake #f3dfb8 with pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 dripping from its top edge; the stone castle becomes a round cake tower with white whipped cream on top; the red sails become white cream sails; the masts become pink and white striped candy canes; the pennants become pale pink. Nothing red. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 carrack as a layered-cake galleon with candy-cane masts.

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a donut raft: the hull becomes one big fat ring donut of golden biscuit-brown dough #d9a05b floating flat, with thick glossy pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 and tiny white sprinkles on its top; the red tarp becomes a heap of white whipped cream in its middle; the pennant pole becomes a small pink and white candy cane. Nothing red. Keep the oars, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 barge as a floating donut ring.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only one thing: erase the blue water and the blue wave lines under the hull, so the bottom of the chocolate hull is the lowest thing in the image, with nothing under it; do not redraw anything else. Keep the chocolate hull, the pink frosting, the wafer sail, the candy-cane mast, the pennant, shapes, colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: candy-patrol-boat-a is the right boat, but the edit drew blue water under the hull (the shared ship has none; the board draws the water).

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a candy submarine: remove the mast, the wafer sail and the pennant; the hull becomes one closed fat eclair-shaped hull of the same dark chocolate #5a3423 with a thick stripe of pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 along its top; on top a round pink gumdrop conning tower with a pink and white striped candy-cane periscope; two round pale mint candy portholes; a swirl lollipop at the stern. Nothing red. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The accepted Candy Patrol Boat as a chocolate eclair submarine with a gumdrop tower and a candy-cane periscope.

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a candy submarine: remove the mast, the wafer sail and the pennant; the hull becomes one closed fat cigar-shaped capsule, rounded at both ends, of the same dark chocolate #5a3423 with pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 dripping along its top and three round pale mint candy portholes along its side; on top one small pink gumdrop tower with a candy-cane periscope. Nothing red. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: candy-submarine-a is a square chocolate block on a frosted slab and reads as a cake; this one asks for a rounded capsule hull with the portholes along its side.

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a small stubby candy submarine lying level, no longer than the boat's hull is now: remove the mast, the wafer sail and the pennant; the hull becomes one closed short fat capsule, rounded at both ends, of the same dark chocolate #5a3423 with pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 dripping along its top and three round pale mint portholes in a row; on top one small pink gumdrop tower with a candy-cane periscope. Nothing red. Keep the thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: candy-submarine-b is the right submarine but 69 px wide on the 72 px canvas (x 1 to 69): its ends reach the HP bar and seat badge strips. This one asks for a stubby capsule no longer than the boat's hull, lying level.
